labels.description: Epicentro e fundacao do som rominimal mundial. Lancamentos seletos em vinil e promos ultrarrestritos.

labels.pitch_subject: DJ Promo List Request : Gigantera ([a:rpia:r] Club Support & Feedback)
labels.pitch_body:
Dear [a:rpia:r] curation team,

I have been closely following your catalog and sonic identity for years, deeply inspired by your refined acoustic dynamics, micro-textures, and extended-format storytelling.

I am currently programming dedicated club sessions and recording mix podcasts focused on Romanian minimal, microhouse, and abstract soundscapes.

I would be honored to be considered for your promo list. I actively provide structured feedback on pre-releases within 48 hours, and every supported cut receives direct playout across my club gigs and studio mixes.

My primary promo intake address (compatible with Inflyte and FATdrop) is: konceptrenassans@gmail.com.

SoundCloud / Mixes: https://soundcloud.com/gigantera

Looking forward to hearing your latest works and supporting your upcoming vinyl and digital releases.

Best regards,
Felipe Conceicao (Gigantera)
konceptrenassans@gmail.com
https://soundcloud.com/gigantera
